# case styles — `constants/`

## Project layout

    constants/
    └─ [NAME=S+].ts 0+  a constant

A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

In `[NAME=S+]`, the text after `=` is a mask: each character matches one character of the name. `S` matches a capital letter, digit or underscore. `+` repeats the element before it one or more times. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.
